verdict.rationale: Gusto documents an official remote MCP server (mcp.api.gusto.com) that lets users reach their Gusto data in natural language from Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor, using scoped OAuth access. It also ships an agent-friendly CLI with AGENTS.md and bundled agent skills, so an agent can run per-cycle payroll prep from a single chat session. The Embedded Dev Assistant MCP adds natural-language access to the Embedded API for developers. Missing for 10: clear evidence the user MCP supports write actions rather than only data access, any ability to run or submit payroll (the CLI only drafts it and gates writes behind --confirm), a native in-app natural-language assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration.
